provenance.pubchem_citation: Kim S, Chen J, Cheng T, et al. PubChem 2025 update. Nucleic Acids Res. 2025;53(D1):D1516-D1525. doi:10.1093/nar/gkae1059
provenance.notes: Easy-tier central metabolite + minimal charged ion (08-PROPOSALS.md Set 2, APPROVED 2026-09-26): citric acid CID 311 (free acid as-recorded per Decision 5; deprotonatized citrate sourcing REJECTED for v1) + acetate anion CID 175 (the set's salt-bridge carrier, formal charge -1). Per-record citation per U1: 'PubChem Identifier: CID <CID>; URL: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/<CID>'. Complex reference metadata: CC0 1.0 (wwPDB).

Citric acid, PubChem CID 311 (C6H8O7, 13 heavy, Charge 0 as recorded). Complex: 8FUY Crithidia fasciculata G6PDH citrate-bound (CIT + CL in inventory; research's top hit 1O7X REJECTED at confirmation - no nonpolymer entities, C5). Primary paper DOI: NONE RECORDED in the RCSB data - honest absence, not an omission to invent. Neutral free acid per Decision 5: COOH-never-anion guard, carboxylates NOT salt-bridge-typed; the set's salt-bridge slot is acetate. Carries rich h_bond (4 OH-type donors - 3 COOH + 1 alcohol; 7 O acceptors), hydrophobic.

Acetate anion, PubChem CID 175 (C2H3O2-, 4 heavy, Charge -1 as recorded - the deprotonated anion CHOSEN over acetic acid deliberately: it is the salt-bridge carrier; carboxylate charge-group typing requires the recorded charge). Complex: 5YS8 succinate-acetate permease (ACT in inventory; paper DOI resolves 200). Carries salt_bridge (carboxylate -1 charged group), h_bond (carboxylate O acceptors), hydrophobic (methyl). FILE is the set-scoped demo-easy-2-acetate.sdf; the dev set's legacy ligands/acetate.sdf is a different script-built file and stays untouched.
